meta_title: W York & Daughter Electrical | Electrician Nottingham
meta_description: W York & Daughter Electrical is a trusted local electrician in Nottingham. NICEIC registered, domestic and commercial work, emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Blown fuse? Flickering lights? We're here for all your electrical repairs and installations across Nottingham.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires and new installations, we handle domestic and commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped circuits, or dead sockets? We attend emergency callouts 24/7 and usually arrive within the hour. No call-out charge.

services.title: Full House Rewires
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? We manage complete rewires with full certification and minimal disruption to your family.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Installation
services.desc: Professional installation of gas boilers and electric heating systems with all necessary electrical upgrades and testing.

services.title: Lighting & Switching
services.desc: New ceiling lights, wall lights, dimmer switches, and decorative fittings installed to your specification with safe, clean wiring.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Older fuse boxes replaced with modern, safe consumer units to protect your home and meet Building Regulations.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial Wiring
services.desc: Wiring, fault-finding, and maintenance for shops, offices, and light industrial premises across the Nottingham area.

about_pullquote: I started this business to do the job right and treat every customer like family.
about_para_1: W York & Daughter Electrical has been serving Nottingham for nearly three decades. Founded on the principle that good electrical work is safe, honest, and fairly priced, we've grown from a one-man operation to a respected local firm. Every member of our team is NICEIC registered and carries full certification.
about_para_2: We're known in Nottingham for turning up on time, finishing the job properly, and explaining everything in plain English—no jargon. Repeat customers make up over 60% of our work, which tells you we do what we promise. Whether it's a blown fuse at midnight or a full commercial rewire, you'll get the same care and attention.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them out at 11pm on a Saturday with no power in half the house. Chap arrived at 11:45 and found a faulty switch. Sorted in 20 minutes and didn't even charge the call-out fee because it was quick. Proper professionals.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had them do a full rewire on our 1960s terrace. The team was tidy, efficient, and explained everything as they went. They left the site clean every single day. Would definitely have them back. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Claire B.

reviews.text: Emergency call with a burning smell from the consumer unit. They were here in 50 minutes, diagnosed a dodgy connection, and had it safe again by tea time. Really put our minds at ease. Very grateful.
reviews.author: Robert K.
